caption: Porta Maggiore, Rome
composition: Travertine aqueduct gate with twin roadway arches and stacked Aqua Claudia channels · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The travertine gate fills the frame, its two great roadway arches at the center flanked by weathered stone, with two stacked tiers of small arched openings running the full width above. A fragment of older wall runs off at the left, and a modern road passes beneath the arches. At 12:11 the midday sun lights the pale stone flatly, and the repeated arches of the upper level give the whole structure its rhythm.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Porta Maggiore under morning light
